t: Long Beach → Syracuse · Jerome Baker run

d.note: Top **JB-fit** doors on the drive line (fit 75–92). Farmingdale first, then straight up the Hudson and west on the Thruway. **Tight day** — if you leave late, drop Utica (Exit 31) and pick it up on the way home.

North-to-south sweep of Onondaga County, ~65 mi total — a light drive, so these are the long conversations. **Flynnstoned Walton St is COD-only** (OCM list). Ends at LakeHouse in Cortland, right on I-81 south for the ride home.
